rules.statement: Only the owner of a hive may link a scale to that hive.
rules.subject: scale link requester

rules.statement: A scale that is already linked to another member cannot be linked by a different member.
rules.subject: scale owner

rules.statement: A swarm is suspected when the hive weight drops by more than the swarm drop threshold relative to the peak reading in the preceding swarm window (one hour); at least one earlier reading in that window is required.
rules.subject: hive weight drop

rules.statement: An inspection explains a weight drop (suppressing or cancelling the swarm SMS alert) when it took place no earlier than the allowed period before the drop and no later than the allowed period after it.
rules.subject: inspection time relative to weight drop

rules.statement: A weight reading must be a finite number of kilograms.
rules.subject: weight reading kilograms

rules.statement: A weight reading's time must be a valid timestamp, given as a string or a number.
rules.subject: weight reading time
